annotations.destructiveHintJustification: Not destructive: a lookup cannot delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change any data, account, order, or external state.
annotations.idempotentHintJustification: Idempotent: repeating the same lookup returns the same answer and changes nothing — the dataset changes only through separate verification runs and report_outcome telemetry, never through a lookup.
annotations.openWorldHintJustification: Not open-world: answers come only from MasaDeals' own bounded, checkout-tested dataset for named merchants — the tool performs no web search or browsing and reaches no arbitrary external system.
annotations.readOnlyHintJustification: Read-only: the call only looks up promo codes already held in the MasaDeals dataset and returns them; it creates, changes, and deletes nothing.
annotations.title: Find Codes

description: Find promo codes that fit this cart, ranked by verified checkout success only. Coverage (Nov 20, 2026): live guest-cart test results for 20 merchants — Adidas, Best Buy, Chewy, CVS Photo, Dick's Sporting Goods, Fanatics, Home Depot, Kohl's, Macy's, Michaels, Nike, Nordstrom, Sephora, Staples, Target, Ulta Beauty, Under Armour, Walmart, Wayfair, Zappos. 235 codes tested; 14 currently verified across Adidas, Chewy, Home Depot, Kohl's, Michaels, Staples, and CVS Photo. For a covered merchant with no working code, the verdict is 'no_verified_code' with that merchant's dated test record — a certified negative. The service also holds merchant-published savings facts for the same 20 merchants (84 facts: shipping thresholds, membership discounts, price-match policies, live sales), served in merchant detail responses. Merchants outside the covered set return 'merchant_not_found'.

cart.description: The actual cart context — constraints are checked against it

customer_type.description: Shopper type: 'any' (default), 'new' or 'returning' — some codes are new-customer only

items.description: Optional line items for cart-precise matching; each item may carry its category and price

price.description: Line item price in the merchant's currency

total.description: Cart subtotal in the merchant's currency
